spans.s:
‘kṛṣṇacarita’
suppositious name of a work giving a resume of the Kṛṣṇa story. Dacca.

‘kṛṣṇadevarāyakṛti’
twelve autobiographical verses by king Kṛṣṇadevarāya of Vijayanagar.

.
This is no separate work; these verses formed part of the Sakalakathāsaṅgraha ascribed to him.
See JOR. Madras XIII. p.. 195-6.

‘kṛṣṇapūrvavaṃśya’
caitanya. a short work on the family companions, neighbours etc. of Śrīkṛṣṇa an. Rādhā; similar to Śrīgaṇoddeśadīpikā or Rādhākṛṣṇagaṇoº of Rūpa. C.. X.
(refers to Rūpa in the last verse).

‘kṛṣṇalīlā’
Sk. X. i-ii of Bhāgavatapurāṇa.
Pt.. with glosses, Bengali paraphrases, an. chs. in Bengali on Vaiṣṇava doctrines etc. Calcutta, 1904. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 492.

‘kṛṣṇaḥ_Sarvātmakaḥ’
vallabhīya. C. on the above verse by Haridāsa. Udaipur
